brief:
Acting head of Israel's Central Elections Committee said Knesset elections were conducted in accordance with the law, according to Maan Wire. The official stated that ballot integrity was maintained with utmost care at polling stations and that available information provides no basis for claims of systematic interference with electoral integrity.

The statement came as the committee addressed allegations regarding the election process.

title: Israel's election chief declares Knesset vote conducted legally
